title: Bind CDC view metadata and columns
objective: CDC view, column and documentation identities are consistently linked without treating a visual/dashboard catalog entry as a queryable table.
outcome: Socrata view metadata is resolved by source-native ID. Tabular datasets stay in the row-sample queue; documents, visualizations and external links stay out. Wire fieldName, labels, types, descriptions, code values and custom-field evidence are preserved. PLACES produces 154 documented fields without inferring geography completeness or a person-level grain. All baseline CDC IDs have a reconciled extraction receipt; four isolated records stay in explicit compatibility/missing-data handling. No source record disappears.

commits.subject: Resolve exact Socrata view metadata
commits.instructions: Fetch the publisher view identified by its source-native ID; distinguish a tabular dataset from a document, visualization or external link.
commits.verification: Fixtures for each asset type keep non-tabular records out of the row-sample queue.

commits.subject: Extract columns and metadata roles
commits.instructions: Preserve wire fieldName, labels, types, descriptions, code values and custom-field evidence. Keep row label, date roles and geographic assertions separate.
commits.verification: PLACES produces its 154 documented fields without inferring geography completeness or a person-level grain.

commits.subject: Build the CDC extraction receipt
commits.instructions: Reconcile all baseline CDC IDs, dictionary eligibility and parser outcomes. Carry four currently isolated records into explicit compatibility/missing-data handling.
commits.verification: No source record disappears; dictionary counts are based on record IDs with parse receipts, not the number of fetched pages.
